sections.title: Investment Recommendation
sections.text: Costco’s high‑volume, low‑margin model remains durable, backed by strong free cash flow and a robust return on equity [[COST.ratio.return_on_average_equity]] [source:K:L129]. The modest debt‑to‑equity ratio [[COST.ratio.debt_to_equity]] adds financial flexibility [source:K:L191]. However, the price‑earnings multiple [[COST.ratio.price_earnings]] is elevated relative to peers, indicating that the market has priced in much of the growth outlook [source:K:L233]. Execution risk around expansion, cyber‑security threats, and ongoing litigation also temper the outlook [source:K:L252] [source:Q:L508]. Considering the strong fundamentals but premium valuation, the recommendation is Hold.

insight.text: Low debt relative to equity supports financial flexibility
